name: Remove Leads from List
summary: Removes one or more leads from a static list (up to 300 IDs per call). The lead records themselves are untouched.
whenToUse: When you need to take people off a manual list — e.g. removing them from a campaign audience or an exclusion list.
confirm: Remove the listed leads from this static list (membership only — the lead records themselves are NOT deleted). Continue?

path.name: listId
path.label: List ID
path.hint: Find it via Get Static Lists.

query.name: id
query.label: Lead ID(s)
query.hint: Comma-separated lead IDs to remove. Max 300 per call.

response.description: One status per lead ID: removed or skipped (e.g. 'Lead not found').

notes: Only removes the membership — the lead record and everything else about it stay.
